name: Catedral Primada de Toledo

position.source: https://www.openstreetmap.org/relation/1605452 (the crossing of nave and transept, from the outline and its building:parts; axis from the outer walls of the aisles and the west front)

rights.note: Begun 1226, consecrated/closed 1493; cloister 1389–1425; tower 1425–c. 1440 (octagon and spire by Hanequin of Brussels); Mozarabic Chapel c. 1500 with the dome of Jorge Manuel Theotocópuli (1626–1631); sacristy, Sagrario and Ochavo late 16th–17th c.; the Transparente 1729–1732; west front restored by Eugenio Durango 1775–1780.

notes: Built by code (model_sources/Q1123180_catedral_de_toledo.py, tools/meshkit.py) with AI assistance. Five naves with a stepped section (outer aisles and chapels 15.5 m, inner aisles 22.5 m, clerestory 32.5 m, ridge 37 m from OSM), seven bays with double flying buttresses, transept with the Puerta de los Leones (south, with its forecourt, lions and railing) and the Puerta del Reloj (north), choir with a seven-sided apse, double ambulatory with radial double flyers and the slate skylight of the Transparente, the octagonal chapels of San Ildefonso and Santiago (battlements), the west front with the Puerta del Infierno, del Perdón and del Juicio Final, the Last Supper relief, the twin arches and pediment, and the compás with its railing; the tower (square shaft with the band of coats of arms and the belfry, octagon with pinnacles and flyers, slate spire with three crowns of spikes, cross and vane to 92 m); the Mozarabic Chapel in the base of the unfinished south tower with Theotocópuli's dome; the Sagrario (slate pyramid and lantern), the Ochavo (octagon, slate dome, lantern), the sacristy, the treasurer's patio and the dependencies; the cloister with its stone arcades, the wooden upper gallery, the rendered top floor and the garden. Uncertain: the heights of the tower's stages (square shaft to 55 m, octagon to 72 m, ±10 %, from photographs), the exact width of the tower's shaft (14 m; OSM draws 18 × 12.6 m with its buttresses), the inner/outer aisle division (±1.5 m), the heights of the dependencies (from their levels in OSM) and the steps between the floor and the streets (the town is ~5 m higher to the north and ~9 m lower to the south-east; the walls go down to 1.5 m below the real ground). Simplified: the tracery, the sculpture of the portals, the interior.
